settingsPage.blikRequirement: The number must be registered to receive BLIK phone transfers in your bank's app, linked to the account the money should go to — otherwise customers are told the number does not accept BLIK transfers. Not every bank allows a business account. Payments are not confirmed automatically: check your bank and mark the consultation as paid.

zonesPage.title: Delivery zones
zonesPage.subtitle: Postal codes we deliver to, and the shipping price for one-time orders. Calendar orders always ship free.
zonesPage.matching: A postal code goes to the active zone with the longest matching prefix — e.g. "00" covers 00-000…00-999, while "00-9" covers only 00-900…00-999.
zonesPage.none: No zones yet. Without an active zone, orders with an address are refused.
zonesPage.name: Name
zonesPage.prefixesHint: Separate with commas or spaces, e.g. 00, 01, 02-9. 1 to 5 digits; the dash is ignored.
zonesPage.priceHint: In złoty, at most two decimal places — e.g. 15.00
zonesPage.priceInvalid: Enter an amount in złoty, e.g. 15.00 — at most two decimal places.
